quote: We compare our method with several Transformer-based baselines, including LONGFORMER , MODERN-BERT , and DEEPSEEK-QWEN-1.5B , all finetuned with LORA . For all models, we use a weight decay of 0.01, a learning rate of 0.0002, a batch size of 16, and set the LORA α parameter to 8. MODERNBERT serves as the Transformer backbone in our model. We set the attention dropout to 0.1, weight decay to 0.01, and learning rate to 0.0002.
